es: Reescribir una misma petición para tres lectores (compañero, profesor, gerente) con registro, suavizado y conectores adecuados a cada uno.

teaching.en: I hate to ask a favour, but could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, and I would gladly cover your shift in return.
teaching.es: Odio pedir un favor, pero ¿podríamos cambiar el jueves por el viernes? Tengo un evento familiar y con gusto cubriría tu turno a cambio.
teaching.explanationEs: Con un compañero basta una pregunta breve con could we; ask a favour suaviza y reconoce el esfuerzo del otro.
segments: I hate to ask a favour, but could we swap Thursday for Friday? I
have a family event, and I would gladly cover your shift in return.
teaching.audioText: I hate to ask a favour, but could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, and I would gladly cover your shift in return.

teaching.en: Would it be possible to move my session to Friday? Friday would be more convenient for me, since I will be away on Thursday.
teaching.es: ¿Sería posible mover mi sesión al viernes? El viernes me vendría mejor, ya que estaré fuera el jueves.
teaching.explanationEs: Would it be possible + razón: neutro y respetuoso, apropiado para un profesor.
segments: Would it be possible to move my session to Friday? Friday would
be more convenient for me, since I will be away on Thursday.
teaching.audioText: Would it be possible to move my session to Friday? Friday would be more convenient for me, since I will be away on Thursday.

teaching.en: I was wondering whether you could rearrange my booking; it would be really helpful if you could accommodate a change this week.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podría reprogramar mi reserva; sería de gran ayuda que pudiera atender un cambio esta semana.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering whether + could suaviza mucho la petición; accommodate es atender o dar cabida a un cambio.
segments: I was wondering whether you could rearrange my booking; it would
be really helpful if you could accommodate a change this week.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering whether you could rearrange my booking; it would be really helpful if you could accommodate a change this week.

teaching.en: With regard to my Thursday booking, it is essential that I change the date, because I will be abroad on business that day.
teaching.es: Con respecto a mi reserva del jueves, es imprescindible que cambie la fecha, porque ese día estaré en el extranjero por trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: Cuando hay urgencia real, essential refuerza la petición; with regard to es una apertura formal.
segments: With regard to my Thursday booking, it is essential that I change
the date, because I will be abroad on business that day.
teaching.audioText: With regard to my Thursday booking, it is essential that I change the date, because I will be abroad on business that day.

teaching.en: In view of the weather, the studio is closed on Thursday; therefore, I would like to move my booking to Friday.
teaching.es: En vista del tiempo, el estudio cierra el jueves; por lo tanto, me gustaría mover mi reserva al viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: In view of + nombre introduce la razón en registro formal; therefore es un conector formal de consecuencia.
segments: In view of the weather, the studio is closed on Thursday;
therefore, I would like to move my booking to Friday.
teaching.audioText: In view of the weather, the studio is closed on Thursday; therefore, I would like to move my booking to Friday.

teaching.en: I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I can come at any time on Friday, so the change should cost you very little.
teaching.es: Pido disculpas por el poco aviso. Además, puedo venir a cualquier hora el viernes, así que el cambio debería suponerle muy poco.
teaching.explanationEs: Moreover añade un dato a favor; apologise suaviza en un mensaje formal.
segments: I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I can come at any

prompt.es: Elige la apertura adecuada para pedir el cambio a tu profesor, el señor Lee.

choices.text: Hey Lee! Can you move my session?
Dear Mr Lee, I was wondering whether you could move my session.
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to request a change to my session.

feedback.es: Conoces su apellido y debes mostrar respeto sin distancia oficial: Dear Mr Lee + I was wondering whether; Hey es demasiado informal y Dear Sir or Madam es para desconocidos.

hint.es: Conoces su nombre y debes mostrar respeto, pero no es un desconocido.

origin.text: You need to ask your teacher, Mr Lee, to move your Thursday session to Friday because of a family event.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me preguntaba si podrías reprogramar mi reserva para el viernes.»

feedback.es: I was wondering whether + could convierte la petición en una pregunta indirecta muy cortés.

hint.es: Es el gerundio del verbo «preguntarse» que suaviza la petición.

origin.text: I know you are busy this week. I was ___ whether you could rearrange my booking for Friday.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podemos intercambiar mi turno por el tuyo?»

answer.text: Could we swap my shift for yours

feedback.es: Swap A for B significa cambiar A por B, y could we suaviza la petición entre compañeros.

prompt.es: Elige la versión que refuerza la petición porque hay urgencia real.

choices.text: I was wondering whether you might possibly move my booking, if it is not too much trouble.
Perhaps you could move my booking at some point, whenever it suits the team.
It is essential that I move my booking today, because my flight has been cancelled.

feedback.es: Essential marca que el cambio es imprescindible y la razón lo justifica; las otras dos suavizan la petición hasta restarle urgencia.

origin.text: Situation: your flight was cancelled this morning, and you must change your hotel booking today.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ofrece Mia a cambio del cambio de turno.

choices.text: To cancel her own Friday shift.

feedback.es: Mia ofrece cubrir el turno del sábado de Sam a cambio: es la forma de compensar el favor que pide.

origin.audio: Hi Sam, it's Mia. Could we swap Thursday for Friday? I hate to ask a favour, but I have a family event that I can't move. I'd cover your Saturday shift in return, so you'd really be helping me out. Cheers!

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector o expresión con su significado.

feedback.es: Therefore marca consecuencia, moreover suma un dato, however contrasta e in view of introduce la razón.

prompt.es: Escribe tres versiones de la petición: para Sam, para Mr Lee y para el gerente.

answer.text: To Sam: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, so Friday would be much easier for me. I hate to ask a favour, but I can cover your Saturday shift in return. Cheers! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, would it be possible to move my session to Friday? I will be away on Thursday because of a family event, and I apologise for the short notice. I can come at any time on Friday. Thank you for your time. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing with regard to my booking for Thursday. In view of a family event, it is essential that I change the date, and I would be grateful if you could rearrange it for Friday. Kind regards, Mia Soto
accepted: To Sam: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, so Friday would be much easier for me. I hate to ask a favour, but I can cover your Saturday shift in return. Cheers! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, would it be possible to move my session to Friday? I will be away on Thursday because of a family event, and I apologise for the short notice. I can come at any time on Friday. Thank you for your time. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing with regard to my booking for Thursday. In view of a family event, it is essential that I change the date, and I would be grateful if you could rearrange it for Friday. Kind regards, Mia Soto

To Sam: Hi Sam, can we swap Thursday for Friday? There is a family event, so it would help me a lot. I hate to ask a favour, but I will cover your Saturday shift if you like. Thanks! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, I was wondering whether I could move my session to Friday. I have a family event on Thursday, and I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I can come at any time that day. Kind regards, Mia. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my Thursday booking. In view of a family event, it is essential that I change the date. Would it be possible to rearrange it for Friday? I would be grateful for any help. Kind regards, Mia Soto

To Sam: Hello Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event and Friday suits me better. I know it is a big favour, so I will buy you a coffee. Cheers! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, would you mind if I moved my session to Friday? I will be away on Thursday for a family event. I apologise for the short notice; therefore, I can be flexible about the time. Thank you for your understanding. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, with regard to my booking for Thursday, I would be most grateful if you could accommodate a change to Friday. A family event makes it essential that I rearrange it. Kind regards, Mia Soto

feedback.es: Cada versión adapta el saludo, la forma de pedir y el cierre al lector, con la misma razón en las tres.

origin.text: Petición: cambiar tu sesión del jueves al viernes por un evento familiar. Escribe tres mensajes cortos: uno para Sam (compañero; le ofreces cubrir su turno del sábado), otro para Mr Lee (profesor; pides disculpas por el poco aviso) y otro para el gerente del servicio (desconocido; urgencia real). Cada uno con su saludo, su petición suavizada y su cierre.

evidenceGroups: i am writing with regard to

prompt.es: Elige el conector que expresa la consecuencia en el mensaje.

feedback.es: Therefore presenta la consecuencia del corte de luz (quiere mover la reserva); moreover suma información y however contrasta.

origin.text: The studio is closed on Thursday because of a power cut. ___ I would like to move my booking to Friday, if that is possible.

prompt.es: Completa: «Además, puedo venir a cualquier hora el viernes; el cambio costará poco.»

feedback.es: Moreover añade un dato a favor en registro formal, justo después de la disculpa.

origin.text: I apologise for the short notice. ___, I can come at any time on Friday, so the change should cost you very little.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige a quién escribe la persona y qué da a entender de su situación.

choices.text: A friend; she implies the delay is only a joke.
A company; she implies she wants compensation.
A teacher; she implies the delay is beyond her control.

feedback.es: Dear Ms Brown y I was wondering whether… apuntan a una profesora; la enfermedad explica un retraso que no controla.

origin.audio: Dear Ms Brown, I was wondering whether I could hand in my essay on Monday instead. I know the deadline was today, and I apologise for asking so late, but I have been ill all week. I would be very grateful if you could accommodate this request.

prompt.es: ¿Qué impresión puede causar este mensaje en el gerente y por qué?

choices.text: That the writer is careless: a casual request clashes with the formal frame.
That the writer is very polite, because of the apology for the short notice.
That the writer is demanding, because of the deadline for the answer.

feedback.es: «Hey, could you swap it…?» y «Cheers» son informales y chocan con el saludo formal y con I would be grateful if you could: el mensaje puede parecer descuidado.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing with regard to my booking for Thursday at ten. In view of a family event, it is essential that I change the date, and I would be grateful if you could rearrange it for Friday. Hey, could you swap it for the morning? That would be great. I can also send any documents you need in advance. I apologise for the short notice, and I trust this will not cause you too much inconvenience. Cheers, Mia Soto

prompt.es: Completa: «Es imprescindible que cambie mi reserva, porque estaré fuera el jueves.»

feedback.es: Essential refuerza la petición cuando hay urgencia real; las fórmulas suaves no transmitirían esa necesidad.

origin.text: The studio is very busy this week. It is ___ that I change my booking, because I will be away on Thursday.
